title.en: Add grade-aware vocabulary order and reliable learning interactions
title.zh: 新增学段词汇排序与可靠学习交互

purpose.en: Teach the easiest useful words first across SmartLingo while making Slow speech audibly distinct and sentence building a meaningful choice task.
purpose.zh: 在 SmartLingo 全部学习入口优先教授最容易且最实用的词，同时让慢速语音真正可辨，并让组句成为有有效干扰项的选择练习。

en: Give every published vocabulary item a recommended grade from 0 (K/Pre-K) through 12 and display difficulty, frequency, and grade together on learner-facing word cards, tiles, and items.
Use one deterministic easiest-first order: difficulty ascending, frequency descending, grade ascending, then catalog sequence.
Give every sentence builder the exact answer length plus at least two unique distractor words and score automatically when all answer slots are filled.
Apply distinct Normal 0.84× and Slow 0.42× speech synthesis behavior across Sprint, courses, SmartCard, and Everyday Speaking surfaces.
zh: 为每个已发布词汇增加 0（幼儿园/学前）至 12 的建议学段，并在面向学员的词卡、tile 与词条上同时展示难度、频率和学段。
统一采用确定性的由易到难排序：难度升序、频率降序、学段升序，最后按词库序号。
每个组句题均提供与答案相同数量的空位及至少两个不重复干扰词，并在填满空位后自动判分。
在今日速成、课程、SmartCard 与生活口语中统一应用可区分的正常 0.84× 与慢速 0.42× 语音。

en: SmartLingo vocabulary schema and migration, vocabulary/Sprint/SmartCard/course APIs, reusable sentence and speech engines, and all learner-facing vocabulary surfaces.
The change is isolated to smartlingo.net and does not alter Clerk, payments, Cloudflare resource boundaries, sibling sites, or external-service configuration.
zh: 影响 SmartLingo 词汇数据库结构与迁移、词汇/今日速成/SmartCard/课程 API、可复用组句与语音引擎，以及全部面向学员的词汇界面。
变更仅限 smartlingo.net，不修改 Clerk、支付、Cloudflare 资源边界、兄弟站点或外部服务配置。

en: Backfill all 48,000 published multilingual vocabulary rows into 13 bounded grade bands and add a database learning-order index and deployment completeness gate.
Centralize grade validation, bilingual labels, and the learning comparator so database queries, seeded lessons, daily practice, Sprint, SmartCard, and course vocabulary agree.
Queue browser speech after cancellation to prevent Safari from reusing a prior utterance rate, select a matching language voice, and bound playback cleanup.
Generate plausible language-specific distractors from the active round before falling back to simple common words.
zh: 把 48,000 个已发布多语种词汇回填至 13 个受约束学段，增加数据库学习顺序索引及部署完整性门禁。
集中管理学段校验、双语标签与学习排序比较器，使数据库查询、预置课程、每日练习、今日速成、SmartCard 和课程词汇保持一致。
取消旧语音后建立浏览器队列边界，避免 Safari 复用前一次语速，并匹配目标语言 voice、限制播放清理时间。
优先从当前学习轮次生成目标语言的合理干扰词，只有孤立题目才使用简单常用词后备。

en: All 362 repository tests pass, including the exact 48,000-row grade distribution, comparator order, Slow 0.42× mapping, three-attribute UI contracts, and answer-plus-two sentence choices.
TypeScript, changed-file ESLint with zero errors, whitespace validation, the production vinext build, and shared site policy/architecture/base-feature contracts pass.
GitHub Actions additionally rejects a deployment unless all 48,000 published rows have valid difficulty, frequency, and grade values covering all 13 grades.
zh: 仓库 362 项测试全部通过，包括精确的 48,000 行学段分布、排序比较器、慢速 0.42× 映射、三属性 UI 合同及答案加两个干扰词。
TypeScript、修改文件 ESLint 零错误、空白校验、生产 vinext 构建及共享站点政策/架构/基础功能合同均通过。
GitHub Actions 还会在 48,000 个已发布词未全部具有合法难度、频率、学段且未覆盖 13 个学段时阻止部署。

en: Grade is a SmartLingo recommended learning-grade and age-of-acquisition proxy derived from the reviewed catalog order, not an official school-board certification; future corpus review may refine individual rows without changing the 0–12 contract.
Browser automation can verify the utterance rate supplied to speech synthesis but cannot fabricate a physical speaker-duration measurement.
zh: 学段是从已审核词库顺序推导的 SmartLingo 建议学习学段与习得年龄代理，并非官方教育局认证；后续语料审核可细化单词学段，但不改变 0–12 合同。
浏览器自动化可以核验传给语音合成器的语速，但不会虚构实体扬声器的时长测量。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's 12-language vocabulary, original learning UI, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, anonymous cookie boundaries, signed-in database progress, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare delivery.
Do not import Duolingo artwork, copy, code, or proprietary data; the interaction remains a SmartLingo implementation informed by successful learning patterns.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 的 12 语种词库、原创学习 UI、跟读默认关闭、匿名 Cookie 边界、登录用户数据库进度，以及 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布流程。
不导入 Duolingo 的美术、文案、代码或专有数据；交互仍是借鉴成功学习模式的 SmartLingo 自有实现。
